neighbours.label: the last digit of a three-digit number that starts with 8 (850, 825, 870): digit-level reading of an 8xx number; the same position in 1xx-4xx numbers stays low
fire: For bookings, ring our office at (850) 312-7714 any weekday.
The turbine is rated at 860 kilowatts in strong wind.
Our hotel room on the top floor was number 825.
Tickets for the show cost 850 rupees at the door.
The pass climbs to 870 metres before dropping into the valley.
Their new sedan has a range of about 840 kilometres per tank.
Please dial (850) 224-9031 to reach the help desk.
The library holds roughly 830 rare maps from the colonial era.

notes: Card: top peaks on '0'/'5' ending '(850)', '850 MW', '925', '820-2865', '825 calibre'. Digits tokenize singly. Probe: '(850) 452' 0.938, '825 horsepower' 0.626, '920 dollars' 0.359, '850 MW' 0.285; '(350)' 0.058, '450 MW' 0.031, '85 people' 0.004. 9xx may also fire, so near misses use 1xx-4xx.
